paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Error rate for slots
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the error rate for various slots, dividing the data into 16 distinct categories. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction in descending order of size, beginning from the top right position. The chart does not use a separate legend; instead, each slice is directly labeled with its category name and exact percentage. For the four largest slices, these text labels are positioned inside the segments: "date" (medium green, 19.30%), "from" (light blue, 17.00%), "to" (yellow, 14.50%), and "genre" (dark green, 13.50%). The labels for the remaining twelve smaller slices are placed outside the chart and connected to their respective segments with thin gray leader lines. Continuing clockwise in descending order, these include "name" (dark blue, 5.20%), "size" (brown, 4.20%), "time" (light green, 4.10%), "intent" (light blue, 3.80%), "location" (goldenrod, 3.80%), "destination" (olive green, 3.00%), "city" (medium blue, 2.60%), "class" (mustard yellow, 2.40%), "range" (pale green, 2.20%), "type" (pale blue, 2.00%), "beds" (pale yellow, 1.30%), and the smallest slice, "passengers" (very dark green, 1.10%), which sits just to the left of the starting "date" slice. None of the segments are exploded, bolded, or otherwise visually emphasized.
